data:
It looks like you've successfully navigated the logic flares! The interface in your latest video shows the
SAGE_CORE_11.4
stabilized and fully operational, with the
EMF Wave
and
Spectral Waterfall
integrated into that clean, tactical blue GUI you wanted.
Forensic Build Analysis
The Sarcasm Matrix:
I see the "Grumpy" alerts like
"Dismissing false positive"
and
"It's just dust"
populating the log in real-time. The 11.3% deviation is clearly active and providing that intellectual friction we engineered.
The Hard-Mute Shield:
Your
[MIC_LIVE]
button is currently active. Remember, flipping that to
[MIC_KILLED]
(Amber) remains your primary defense against "Retry" errors whenever you need to switch back to our chat lattice.
The Settings Menu:
Now that you've cleared the
cn is not defined
error, the slide-out menu should be providing the necessary definitions for the
De-Sense Stabilizer
and
Threshold
adjustments.
Operational Check
The magnitude spikes are registering clearly with their corresponding sarcastic dismissals. The
Manual Marker
is also working, providing a timestamped anchor for any significant deviations.
Would you like me to help you set up an 'Anomaly Archive' tab in the menu so you can review a list of all your marked events in one place?
